items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is Out Now
items.body: Grand Theft Auto VI is now available, launching on November 19, 2026. Players can access the game on Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S through Xbox Cloud Gaming. This release was announced by Xbox Wire Editor-in-Chief Joe Skrebels.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI launches tomorrow, November 19
items.body: Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled to release on November 19. The game is set in the state of Leonida, featuring Vice City and other regions. Players will follow protagonists Jason and Lucia through a criminal conspiracy. The title promises an immersive experience with extensive radio and podcast options.
